title: Lynx private deploy - standup rapid notes (pre-meeting sketch)
content:
Meeting goal: quick alignment and unblock for LYNX private deployment (VPC + on-prem bundle). Keep to 25 minutes. Focus: M1 milestone, carrier-network handoff, and SRE preflight checklist.

Agenda (25m total)
1) 3m - Quick health: "three-line status" for execs (App, Infra, Data).
2) 7m - Milestone callouts: who is green/amber/red and why.
3) 8m - Blockers deep-dive (S1 first).
4) 5m - Action items + owners + deadlines.
5) 2m - Parking-lot + next sync cadence.

Three-line status (prep bullets, speak quickly)
- App: Model serving validated on staging; quantized variant shows +2% throughput. Smoke test flaky around p99 on long convo paths.
- Infra: VPC peering complete in us-west (ops), awaiting firewall rules from carrier for gov subnet. Autoscaler test pending.
- Data: KV-cache warmup script stable in dev; customer wants logs forwarded to their SIEM (TLS cert exchange outstanding).

Milestones (owner / current state / quick notes)
- M1: VPC peering + cert exchange -> owner: Priya Nair -> status: amber -> note: carrier firewall rule (ticket with carrier opened, ETA 48h).
- M2: On-prem appliance install + validation -> owner: Diego Alvarez -> status: red -> note: PXE image mismatch; engineering PR pending for image tag fix.
- M3: Observability + log forwarding -> owner: Mika Tanaka -> status: amber -> note: SIEM schema mapping in progress, needs sample logs.
- M4: Cutover dry-run -> owner: Omar Rahman -> status: green -> note: dry-run scheduled Fri 2026-03-19, limited traffic.

Blockers (priority, description, impact, owner)
- S1: Firewall rules not allowing control-plane -> impact: deployment freeze for staging->prod. Owner: Priya Nair. Mitigation: escalate to carrier PM (CC: Tony), propose temporary SSH bastion (risk: compliance).
- S1: PXE image tag mismatch causes installer aborts -> impact: cannot complete on-prem installs -> Owner: Diego Alvarez. Mitigation: hotfix PR (#78) in review; need CI to run image-build test.
- S2: SIEM TLS cert + schema unknowns -> impact: logs stale, observability blind spots -> Owner: Mika Tanaka. Mitigation: request sample logs and cert chain by EOD Thu.
- S3: Autoscaler config oscillation at 4-8 nodes during spikes -> impact: cost + p99 latency blips -> Owner: Omar Rahman. Mitigation: hold scale-down window for next dry-run.

Decisions needed before next sync
- Approve temporary bastion for carrier workaround? (Priya)
- Approve emergency image tag roll (automated rollback policy must be in place) (Diego)
- Confirm log retention and PII redaction policy for customer SIEM ingest (Mika + Legal)

Action items (clear owner, what, due)
- Priya: Follow up with carrier PM + escalate firewall rule; confirm ETA and paste carrier ticket ID here. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Diego: Merge hotfix PR for PXE image tag; kick off image-build CI and post logs. Due: 2026-03-13 (EOD).
- Mika: Produce sample log set (anonymized) + cert chain and deliver to customer security. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Omar: Run a dry-run plan doc and list rollback steps; share runbook snippet in Confluence. Due: 2026-03-17.
- SRE (oncall): Add scale-down hold annotation to autoscaler config for the dry-run. Owner: SRE (Alex B.). Due: 2026-03-18.

Notes to self / talking points
- Emphasize fallback: "amber-mode" (route to hosted fallback) if private capacity <80% for >10min. Explain cost + SLA tradeoffs.
- Keep exec three-line status short and solution oriented. Avoid deep infra jargon when presenting to customer execs.
- Ask customer for a single security contact for cert exchange to reduce churn.

Parking lot (less urgent)
- Review on-prem remote update cadence (monthly vs weekly).
- Post-migration perf regression plan (baseline + smoke prompts).
- Long-term: discuss automated image promotion after integration tests.

Prep checklist for meeting (Omar)
- Paste latest dry-run schedule and runbook link into chat.
- Confirm Priya has carrier ticket ID (if not, escalate before meeting).
- Open PR page for #78 so Diego can share status live.
- Pull a short sample of p99 traces to show progress (3 traces max).

Meeting logistics
- Time: weekly sync Thu 10:00 PT -> 25m boxed.
- Attendees: Priya, Diego, Mika, Omar, Alex B. (SRE), customer leads (Ben H., security).
- Parking-lot owner: Omar.

Quick reminder: keep notes short in the meeting and update this doc immediately after for the customer-facing follow-up (copy + tidy).

Unresolved questions (to capture after meeting)
- If carrier ETA slips beyond 72h, what's plan B? (temporary hosted fallback or delayed cutover)
- Confirm legal requirements for bastion host (log retention, access window).

---
End of prep sketch. Will trim to one-pager before sending to customer.
